action.command: for i in $(seq 1 30); do status=$(docker ps --filter name=keycloak --format "{{.Status}}"); echo "$i: $status"; if echo "$status" | grep -q "Up"; then if curl -s --max-time 3 http://localhost:8080/realms/master >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "KEYCLOAK READY"; break; fi; fi; sleep 10; done; docker logs keycloak 2>&1 | tail -5
